## Goal

State the exact evidence-workflow outcome and explicit non-goals.

## Branch and evidence baseline

Record the base branch/head SHA, active-run check, and every experiment/result/call-ledger path affected.

## Verification

List exact tests, repository audit, workflow run IDs, and whether the detector job was skipped.

## Paid-call and credential impact

State the number of paid POSTs, cache hits/resumes, confirmation path, and secret/permission scope. A governance-only PR must say `0` paid calls.

## Lesson disposition

Record project-specific/no-new-lesson status and the immutable universal promotion pointer when applicable.

- [ ] No active detector task was overwritten
- [ ] Push/PR jobs are read-only and detector-free
- [ ] Remote Actions are full-SHA pinned
- [ ] Full tests and repository audit pass
- [ ] Detector job is skipped on every non-manual event
- [ ] Exact evidence and archived workflow blobs are preserved
